title: Partner sync — evening log
content:
Evening wrap — quick notes (Sofia)

Context: prepping for Wed partner demo (Northbridge). Short-term focus: make the sandbox run end-to-end, have a reliable fallback if model times out, and make the walk-through as frictionless as possible.

Top priorities (tonight):
- [ ] Finalize sandbox API key rotation flow (note: need separate key per partner, TTL = 24h for demo)
- [ ] Add webhook signing verification example to README (shared with partner)
- [ ] Smoke test sample prompts with quantized variant (gpt-lite-q4) and record latency numbers
- [ ] Confirm permission for partner to view minimal logs (redact PII)

Integration checklist (pre-demo runbook):
1) Account & creds
   - create demo account for Northbridge (demo+northbridge@redwood.com) — DONE (Alex)
   - generate API key with limited scope (tokens_read=true) — TODO
2) Network & connectivity
   - ensure connector IP whitelist is added (ticket: INF-699) — In progress (SRE)
   - fallback route configured: hosted -> dedicated pool in us-east-1
3) Webhooks & events
   - signing secret created and shared via Secrets Manager link (send to partner via 1Password)
   - sample payload + verification script saved in repo (see linked PR)
4) Models & quality
   - decide default model for demo: gpt-3.5-redwood or gpt-lite-q4? (tradeoff: latency vs fidelity)
   - prepare 6 golden prompts, edge-case prompts, and reject-response examples
5) Observability & SLOs
   - dashboard: partner-demo route, latency 95p < 300ms, error rate < 1%
   - enable tracing for 24h window around demo
6) UX & handoff
   - slide deck updated with sample API calls and expected outputs
   - one-liner troubleshooting cheatsheet for SE on call

Notes from today's partner call (fragmented):
- They want ability to restrict model family in config UI (ask PM: how quickly can we add a dropdown?)
- Concern about embed storage costs for large corp docs — propose client-side chunking + caching
- Partner asked for SLA on latency, we should offer 'demo SLA' soft promise and follow up with Dedicated pricing

Technical todo snippets (for tomorrow):
- curl example for signing verification:
  curl -X POST https://demo.redwood.ai/hooks/test -H 'X-Signature: sha256=...' -d '{"event":"response.created"}'
- small node snippet to verify: see PR #78 (copy into README)

Open questions / risks:
- If quantized path increases hallucination on legal prompts, do we fallback to higher-precision model automatically? (need ops config)
- Do we permit partner to store embeddings on our hosted bucket? compliance/security to weigh in.
- Is the dedicated pool warmed enough for predictable latency at demo time? (ask infra to pre-warm)

Follow-ups to assign:
- Jordan: add webhook example to README + 1Password secret share (due Tue morning)
- Alex: request IP whitelist from SRE, confirm INF-699 status (in SLA)
- Me (Sofia): prepare demo script + voice notes, record 2-minute run-through and share link

Tomorrow's quick plan:
- 09:00 — morning sync with Alex + Jordan (15m)
- 09:30 — run full sandbox end-to-end (capture logs)
- 11:00 — dry run with SE (30m)
- 15:00 — finalize slide deck and send to partner + CSM

Random notes / fragments to preserve:
- 'If model times out -> show cached reply + note: "Answer may be partial"'
- remind PM about model pinning UI work and label it demo-critical
- Save a copy of the golden prompts under /marketplace/northbridge/golden-prompts.txt

Slack messages to send (snippets):
- To @sre: "hey—can you confirm INF-699 IP whitelist ETA? need before Wed demo otherwise fallback wont work"
- To @pm: "Can we surface model-family selection in the demo UI? will make partner happier and reduce asks"

Evening retrospective (2 lines):
- Good momentum, team shipping tangible artifacts.
- Need one less surprise in infra next time — pre-warm earlier.

End of notes.
summary: Personal evening scratchpad for partner demo prep: checklist, call notes, technical snippets, owners, and next-day plan.
